stages.name: ION STORM
stages.subtitle: The electric frontier
stages.description: Ion blasts shut down your shield. Corrosion eats your hull.

stages.name: SOLAR FOUNDRY
stages.subtitle: The burning machine
stages.description: Heat weakens your guns. Slag bombs explode. Splitters multiply.

stages.name: VOID CITADEL
stages.subtitle: The last stronghold
stages.description: Ships that blink, gravity that slows you, and big beam attacks.
